Bug_Title: MS: Field is a mutable collection which should be package protected (MS_MUTABLE_COLLECTION_PKGPROTECT)
Bug_Details:
A mutable collection instance is assigned to a final static field,
  thus can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package.
  The field could be made package protected to avoid this vulnerability.
  Alternatively you may wrap this field into Collections.unmodifiableSet/List/Map/etc.
  to avoid this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by declaring a public final static mutable List. This allows modification of the list from outside the class, which can lead to unintended side effects.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by creating multiple instances of MutableCollectionBug and calling the showBug method on each instance. Since mutableList is a static mutable field, changes made by one instance affect all instances, leading to unexpected results and causing the test to fail.
